name: Xiaotie (Anthony) Huang
description: Researcher whose 2007 master's work concerned web GIS.
story: In 2007, Xiaotie (Anthony) Huang completed MSc research at University of Waikato titled “Development of a map service”. The Waikato study developed a personalised travel-planning map application using destination data and user preferences, with spatial information served through a tourist-information system.
